notes.title: GAME REWORKED
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iMwkXDUarN4;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] weapons reworked, implemented recoil system
[*] added bullet impact effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/55904920848794fde12b93adeceb0cd6e3acecf7.gif[/img]
[*] maps reworked, expanded with more space to run around
[*] added sprint ability
[*] added super push ( SLAM ) ability. It works same as regular PUSH but higher impulse and smashing enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/cd1b62ec18b7c490c13ffebc916d1baa0cac4ccb.gif[/img]
[*] added ability to double jump
[*] removed strafe ability
[*] added spawning bullet shells on shoot
[*] added enemy body hit decals
[*] improved decals attached to enemies bodies: now they follow bone transformations
[*] done optimizations to support big hordes of enemies and mass dismemberment
[*] replaced old ugly ammo boxes with a cool ones
[*] added health boxes
[*] added camera shakes on shoot, getting damage, PUSH, sprint, etc.
[*] now player can fire continuously by just holding fire button
[*] improved player animations
[*] AI improved and optimized
[*] now kills/dismemberment with pushed/thrown interactables gains ammo and health
[*] now heavy enemies like Girkin or RashistCrawlerBig will easier/faster become able to get up after being ragdolled
[*] now heavy enemies attack can't be interrupt by shooting/pushing because now weapons are firing much faster
[*] now PUSH reload time is gradually increased up to 5s ( previously was always 5s )
[*] now Push button in shown when there are interactables in reach of Push ability, same for SLAM ability
[*] added weapon hide/show sound
[*] added PUSH/SLAM effects
[*] added UI animations on ammo/health changes
[*] added hit decals on landscape
[*] added sound rewerb in toilet room
[*] added additional checks/fixes to player stuck issue due to some enemy stuck somewhere
[*] added UI markers in the Gallery and some other places
[*] added UI marker to toilet in ammo state (that can be picked up)
[*] added final cutscene
[*] enabled movement for some foliage at short range
[*] don't show blood on screen util 70% hp - show more blood when less 30% hp
[*] increased interactable throw impulse and explosion impulse
[*] improved some gameplay sounds
[*] improved cutscenes with some camera shaking
[*] play hide/show animations on interactable grab/release/throw
[*] fixed: able to stuck just equipped toilet in wall
[*] fixed player didn't PUSH if press PUSH button during weapon swap, but PUSH reload was started
[*] fixed game hang if press ESC during loading screen, for example after tutorial level
[*] added tutorials UI section
[*] fixed: explosion didn't damaged enemy if enemy doesn't have any limbs
[*] added Surface Tension - Урожай song
[*] replaced Uruk-Hai LotR with Uruk Hai Theme from Slavic Affairs in start cutscene
[*] fixed possible overlap skip cutscene text with subtitles
[*] many other small fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Big update improving player experience
notes.content:
[h3]Tutorials[/h3]
Added short tutorial for PUSH mechanic - players will only need to play it once. 
But it will be also available via main menu and pause menu

[u]This mechanic is essential, 
It's the reason why player doesn't have enough ammo to kill all enemies.
Please use the PUSH instead of grab&throw all the time))[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/b90a2d3860482945676d51c5639fd7e97c859d90.gif[/img]

Improved Occupier's Dream tutorial - added video

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/2232701c8bc51bb03450ab27de86efa9167ad5a1.gif[/img]

Improved Sticky Mine Launcher tutorial - less text and added video

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/5276d3dfbcadb10ec18bae23697f4b609a430ee3.gif[/img]

[h3]User Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Show weapons list in UI so player can see all available weapons and their ammo.
[*] Display only the amount of ammo in UI ( removed max possible ammo amount ) - some players was confused and seeking for reload button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/75242c91da466b67d51e9eb1335d3997c07fe5c3.png[/img]

[*] Improved visibility of the PUSH availability indicator - now it's will remain transparent during all reload cycle. So it's easier to see if it's reloaded using only peripheral vision.
Also added small transparent indicator in the center of crosshair,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/f647e3cf72a10b879c4f5799db9af431e5c8117b.gif[/img]

[*] Made ammo more visible - all of it is now lit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/5cb329f2d670b1cd90aac84acb8553a62ee3f90c.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Gallery[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added lights to make pictures lit, also added the text "look" on them - many players was confused and didn't know what to do there.
[*] Tuned some sounds/music volume a bit.
[*] Made some enemies faster.
[*] Fixed: music started over when player goes back triggering checkpoint save again.
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prevent player from going out of room too soon in the upper toilet horror sequence.
[*] Removed push and grab/throw paused tutorials from the start of the game.
[*] Fixed: subtitles above rashists adoring toilet were not translated.
[*] Changed Revolver pick up location so it's more notable - many players didn't know where it came from)
[*] Make "Continue" button more notable in paused tutorials.
[*] Added Inverted mouse option as [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2266930/discussions/0/3825284144461810579/]it was requested[/url]
[*] Added white ZBlockers - they will be displayed in places where they can't be removed by player actions - the red ones are removable by player action.
[*] Fixed player was able to simply outrun first fights to Arena1 without any fights
[*] Fixed: interactable hit might not cause damage to enemy due to throttle of hits processing
[*] Fixed: red/blue chair was jumping up too much by the PUSH
[*] Increased damage caused by interactables - because previous fixes to overly rotating interactables by the PUSH reduced damage
[*] Fixed: heavy interactables/enemies was to weakly pushed by blast wave
[*] Fixed missing putin icon in the "Corner of traditional values" of last cutscene
[/list]

Looks like no one has found a secret weapon... which is not really that secret - just forgot to disable it) 
Feel like you will be disappointed after searching every corner for it))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43603201/d63c3791694783971b3133ef7b20be98596addfa.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[list]
[*] Additional fixes for "enemy horde stuck" issue especially it situations when many enemies trying to squeeze through narrow passage.
[*] Increased interactables push impulse power by player's push ability - previous fix to excessively rotating interactables made pushes a bit weak, especially for the benches
[*] Fixed stairs in the last fight - enemies couldn't run through one of the stairs

[*] Fixed skip cutscene text in the english version - changed "press" to "hold"
[/list]
